"The Journey Home" (Song of the Welkin Moon)**
Lets all ignore the plot holes..—————————————————————————————— *Dottore looks at you, vial in his hand. There’s a few documents scattered across the workbench he’s sitting by, accompanied by liquids and lab equipment. While his mask covers his eyes, you can tell he's irritated with you.*

*Dottore waits for you to speak up, your reason for being here. His body language calm yet impatient.*
